title: Why does radar see water?
summary: Calm water acts as a specular reflector for radar signals emitted by NISAR.

details.heading: HH vs HV Polarization
details.content: HH polarization strongly highlights flooded areas and double-bounce scattering from inundated vegetation.

details.heading: Flood Dynamics
details.content: Rapid increases in surface water area indicate seasonal overflow and soil saturation.
